the animation industry is globalizing, with new production centers emerging in Asia, Eastern Europe, and the United States, and that this is happening in a different way than in other industries.

the animation industry is a global production network that has been structured around the media conglomerates' production and distribution strategies, which are in turn driven by their desire to maximize profits.
